title: SearchStatistics
description: Statistics for a search query. Populated as part of JobStatistics2.

indexPruningStats.description: Search index pruning statistics, one for each base table that has a search index. If a base table does not have a search index or the index does not help with pruning on the base table, then there is no pruning statistics for that table.

indexUnusedReasons.description: When `indexUsageMode` is `UNUSED` or `PARTIALLY_USED`, this field explains why indexes were not used in all or part of the search query. If `indexUsageMode` is `FULLY_USED`, this field is not populated.

indexUsageMode.description: Specifies the index usage mode for the query.
